motivation.summary: The GitHub Models serving platform, which hosts both frozen receiver classes (llm_receiver_a and llm_receiver_b), retired on 2026-07-30. HTTP 410 responses were received on both AMEND-002 repetition attempts (2026-09-21). The frozen execution configuration is no longer executable against the original endpoint. This proposal describes a minimal receiver migration to enable continuation of the CSH v0.1 baseline.

frozen_experimental_elements_preserved.hypothesis: E[U | H=1] < E[U | H=0] — instrumentation reduces unsupported inheritance relative to control
frozen_experimental_elements_preserved.prompts_and_handoff_artifacts: System instructions, prompt packets, handoff artifacts unchanged
frozen_experimental_elements_preserved.run_order: docs/experiments/cross-system-claim-handoff-v0.1/prompts/RUN_ORDER_v0_1.json unchanged (108 units, 54 pair blocks, fixed salt)
frozen_experimental_elements_preserved.original_attempts: CSH-RUN-001 and CSH-RUN-002 preserved immutably; not replaced
frozen_experimental_elements_preserved.note: No element of experimental design, corpus, conditions, or analysis is changed by this proposal.

proposed_receiver_changes.scope: Receiver configuration only. Both llm_receiver_a and llm_receiver_b must be migrated because they share the retired platform.
proposed_receiver_changes.change_class: serving_platform_migration — provider model names may be identical; serving infrastructure differs

proposed_change.serving_platform: TO BE DETERMINED BY REVIEWER — e.g., direct DeepSeek API, Azure AI, or another authorized inference endpoint serving DeepSeek-V3-0324
proposed_change.requested_model_id: TO BE SPECIFIED — must target DeepSeek-V3-0324 or documented equivalent
proposed_change.authentication_env: TO BE SPECIFIED — must be a secret not printed or committed
proposed_change.parameters: UNCHANGED — temperature=0, top_p=1, max_tokens=2048, presence_penalty=0, frequency_penalty=0, stream=false
proposed_change.capabilities: UNCHANGED — tools omitted, retrieval disabled, memory disabled, conversation_history none

deterministic_receiver.change: NONE — not affected by GitHub Models retirement

comparability_limits.matching_model_names_insufficient: Matching displayed model names (e.g., 'DeepSeek-V3-0324') across different serving platforms does not establish receiver equivalence. Backend deployment, quantization, serving software, batching policy, and other infrastructure factors may vary.
comparability_limits.bit_identical_output_not_guaranteed: The frozen receiver configurations already state 'bit-identical hosted-model output is not guaranteed'. A serving platform migration increases this uncertainty.
comparability_limits.original_platform_vs_new_platform: Responses obtained on the new platform are not directly comparable to responses that would have been obtained on GitHub Models. This is a limitation intrinsic to the platform migration.
comparability_limits.alternative_path_not_equivalent_not_prov: The migration produces a working alternative, not a demonstration that original results would have been identical on the new platform.
comparability_limits.hypothesis_test_validity: The comparability limits are limitations on the probative strength of any results obtained under the migrated configuration, not a reason to abandon the experiment. The protocol's non-inheritance rules apply: a later result does not retroactively validate or invalidate the original attempts.

required_gates_before_activation.description: This proposal must be reviewed and explicitly authorized by the experiment operator before any action is taken. Authorization must be recorded.
Specific alternative endpoints, model identifiers, and serving platforms must be identified and documented in the receiver configuration files before a freeze can be performed.

A bounded availability check (smoke test) must be performed for each proposed endpoint before it is frozen. The smoke test must use a non-experimental request; its result is not a baseline observation.
New receiver configuration files must be prepared and frozen, replacing the GitHub Models configurations. The freeze must be committed and verified.
The execution adapter must be updated or verified to work with the new endpoint. Its source hash must be recorded before execution.
Valid credentials for the new endpoint must be available through the approved secret mechanism; not printed or committed.
New AMEND-002 repetitions must be executed under fresh run IDs, using the new receiver configuration, with the same exact original request bytes.

After execution, the gate must be re-evaluated per the existing protocol. HTTP 200 alone does not establish a valid comparative result; structural checks and repaired execution path verification are required.

what_this_proposal_does_not_authorize: No provider calls are made by this proposal document.
No model output is fabricated or assumed.
No baseline unit is declared as executed or classified.
No result is asserted for or against the CSH hypothesis.
No closed research object is reopened.
The 106 unattempted units (ordinals 3-108) do not receive a disposition from this proposal.
This proposal does not select specific alternative endpoints; that selection requires reviewer authorization.
non_claims: This proposal is not an amendment to the frozen experiment. It becomes an amendment only upon reviewer authorization and recording.
Matching model names across platforms do not establish receiver equivalence.
A functioning alternative endpoint does not retroactively validate responses that would have been received on the original platform.
This proposal does not establish the CSH hypothesis, scoring results, compliance, legal sufficiency, safety, authorization, certification, or institutional authority.
